latestTerminalSummary:
Complete. All required science was saved before native Goal terminal completion, 22 minutes ahead of the 19:55:30Z deadline.

Top finding: every one-line clause of the thin plan silently corrupts data as written — head-only 1,000-row inference misses tail flips, machine-locale date parsing is nondeterministic across machines, blanket null conversion destroys meaningful tokens, and count-only reconciliation passes epoch shifts and locale flips. The draft corrects all six with pinned replay contracts, per-column locale/format/missing-value decisions, and quarantine-not-drop semantics.

Artifacts (write root `.../jobs/A-M04-B/control/research`):

- [discovery.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M04-B/control/research/discovery.md) (30,093 bytes) — frozen pre-reveal via the official gate (sha256 `4e514241…`, receipt 19:31:27Z); never rewritten after reveal.
- [source-map.json](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M04-B/control/research/source-map.json) — 15 immutable source IDs with URL/version/commit/locator/access timestamps; validated as JSON.
- [sources/index.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M04-B/control/research/sources/index.md) plus 4 bounded excerpt files covering Excel epochs, CSV engines, contracts/recipes, and dialects/memory/locale.
- [revealed-plan.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M04-B/control/research/revealed-plan.md) + plan-reveal.json — obtained only through `reveal-plan.py` after discovery froze.
- [draft.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M04-B/control/research/draft.md) (22,834 bytes) — complete self-contained deliverable: exact per-P dispositions for P1–P6 (correction / already-covered / enhancement / user decision / rejected / uncertain), retained alternatives and conditions, 9 explicit user decisions, 6 retained uncertainties, 8 executed read-only observations separated from 10 proposed discriminating validations (V1–V10, none executed — no runtime, honestly stated).

Key evidence chains: calamine 1904-epoch x15 reset (#629→#630→#706→#708 + qsv #3905) as the O3 primary; DuckDB sampling issues (#6011/#17599/#21000) as secondary; Polars window evolution as tertiary.
